newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Pollux loading 20,000 tonnes soybeans. Nelson loading 22,314 tonnes soymeal. Mary E. loading 31,443 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load soybeans, three to load soymeal and one for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 1,095 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between July 11 and 13, as well as 664 trucks with soymeal and 275 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Loading: 29,592 tonnes soybeans, 18,359 tonnes soymeal. Stocks: no figures available.

Vessels: At public terminal, Suerte loading 44,800 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 50,050 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, no vessel docked. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 5,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 10 trucks carrying 269 tonnes soymeal arrived on July 13. Rail: one wagon arrived carrying 35 tonnes soybeans.
